verdict.rationale: Wave's evidence documents bank-feed import with auto-merge and categorization, plus period-comparison reports for spotting cash-flow trends. Neither is an agent that monitors the ledger and flags spend anomalies or duplicate transactions before close; at most they are adjacent features. No API, MCP, or agent surface could be documented either, since the developer portal was crawl-walled and the probes returned 404s.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
